question: The Central Government approved the Print and Digital Media Association (PADMA) as a self-regulatory body for publishers of news and current affairs across the country. Who heads this organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mool Chand Garg.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mool Chand Garg:-**

 
 
• **He heads the Print and Digital Media Association (PADMA).**
 
• Mool Chand Garg is a veteran journalist and media executive with over 35 years of experience in the industry.
 
• He has worked with leading media organizations such as Zee News, Sahara News, and Dainik Bhaskar.
 
• As the head of PADMA, Garg is responsible for ensuring that member publishers adhere to the code of ethics and guidelines set by the organization.
 
• This includes maintaining editorial independence, accuracy, and fairness in reporting.
 
 
 
• **PADMA:-**
 
 
• It is a self-regulatory body approved by the Central Government for publishers of news and current affairs across the country.
